info.name: Awgment Account API v2 (Phase 2)
info.description: Postman Collection v2.1 for Awgment Headless Multi-Tenant IAM Service (/accounts/v2). Covers Phase 0 (Actuator Probes), Phase 1 (UC-TENANT-01..04, UC-AUTH-01), and Phase 2 (UC-USER-01..07, UC-SYNC-01..02). Import companion environment docs/postman/awgment-local.postman_environment.json and populate local dev secrets before running.

item.name: 00 - Auth (Keycloak 26 Token Helpers)
item.description: Local development helpers to obtain short-lived JWTs from Keycloak 26 realms. Populate secret variables in your Postman Environment (never commit secrets).

request.description: Fetches a Tier 0 awgment-platform-admin JWT from the dedicated Platform Control Realm and stores it in {{platformToken}}.
Fetches a tenant-scoped JWT from {{tenantRealm}} and stores it in {{accessToken}}.
Fetches a Tier 1 awgment-account-admin JWT from {{tenantRealm}} and stores it in {{approverToken}}.

item.name: 01 - Actuator Health Probes
item.description: Unauthenticated Kubernetes/load-balancer liveness and readiness probes.

request.description: Public liveness probe (details hidden).
Public readiness probe (details hidden).

item.name: 02 - Tenants (UC-TENANT-01..04)
item.description: Platform Control Realm endpoints (/accounts/v2/tenants/**). Strictly require a JWT issued by awgment.security.platform-realm holding awgment-platform-admin.

request.description: UC-TENANT-01: Validates tenantId (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,49}$ + denylist), creates PostgreSQL schema tenant_<tenantId>, executes Flyway migrations, seeds SYSTEM + optional bootstrap approver, verifies Keycloak 26 Section 3 realm contract, and activates the tenant.
